title: stackward fleet report v1
description: Output of `stackward audit --ssh --json`: one entry per host, in the order given. Each audited host carries its own report, a stackward.report.v1 document (schema/report.v1.json). Adding an optional field is not a breaking change; removing or renaming a field, or changing a meaning, needs fleet.v2.

generated_at.description: When the fleet run started, RFC 3339 UTC.

failed.description: Hosts that could not be audited.

results.description: Result counts over every audited host.

host.description: The host as given to ssh (a name from the ssh config, user@name or an address).

arch.description: linux architecture of the host, once known.

error.description: Why the host has no report.

cleanup.description: Set when the removal of the temporary directory on the host could not be confirmed after a failure.

report.description: The host's stackward.report.v1 document, for an audited host.
